title: Gavin Williams Rookie RC 2024 Bowman Chrome Baseball Card 77 Cleveland Guardians
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The Gavin Williams Rookie RC 2024 Bowman Chrome Baseball Card 77 features the Cleveland Guardians player in his first year in the Major League Baseball (MLB). This original trading card is made of card stock with a standard thickness and chrome finish, making it a sought-after collectible for fans and collectors alike. It is part of the 2024 Bowman Chrome set by manufacturer Topps and includes various exclusive features such as a hologram, prospect designation, and limited edition status, making it a valuable addition to any baseball card collection.
